SELECT REPLACE(gp.stable_id, CONCAT(sd.cancer_study_identifier, '_'), '') AS value, gp.name AS label, COUNT(sample_profile.genetic_profile_id) AS count FROM sample_profile INNER JOIN sample_derived sd ON sample_profile.sample_id = sd.internal_id INNER JOIN genetic_profile gp ON sample_profile.genetic_profile_id = gp.genetic_profile_id
GROUP BY gp.stable_id, gp.name, sd.cancer_study_identifier ORDER BY value, label

WITH genomic_values AS ( SELECT CONCAT(hugo_gene_symbol, profile_type) AS attributeId,
AS value, CAST(COUNT(*) AS INT) AS count FROM genetic_alteration_derived
!= 'NA' AND profile_type = #{profileType} AND
hugo_gene_symbol = #{filter.hugoGeneSymbol}
GROUP BY hugo_gene_symbol, profile_type, alteration_value ), genomic_sum AS ( SELECT attributeId, SUM(count) AS value_count FROM genomic_values GROUP BY attributeId ) SELECT attributeId, value, count FROM genomic_values UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT attributeId FROM genomic_sum ORDER BY attributeId LIMIT 1), CONCAT(#{genomicDataBinFilters[0].hugoGeneSymbol}, #{profileType})) AS attributeId, 'NA' AS value, CAST( (() - COALESCE((SELECT value_count FROM genomic_sum ORDER BY attributeId LIMIT 1), 0)) AS INT) AS count ORDER BY attributeId, value

WITH cna_values AS ( SELECT hugo_gene_symbol AS hugoGeneSymbol, #{profileType} AS profileType, CASE alteration_value WHEN '2' THEN 'Amplified' WHEN '1' THEN 'Gained' WHEN '0' THEN 'Diploid' WHEN '-1' THEN 'Heterozygously deleted' WHEN '-2' THEN 'Homozygously deleted' ELSE 'NA' END AS label, alteration_value AS value, CAST(COUNT(*) AS INT) AS count FROM genetic_alteration_derived
!= 'NA' AND profile_type = #{profileType} AND
hugo_gene_symbol = #{filter.hugoGeneSymbol}
GROUP BY hugo_gene_symbol, alteration_value ), cna_sum AS ( SELECT hugoGeneSymbol, SUM(count) AS value_count FROM cna_values GROUP BY hugoGeneSymbol ) SELECT hugoGeneSymbol, profileType, label, value, count, NULL AS uniqueCount, NULL AS sampleIdsStr FROM cna_values UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT hugoGeneSymbol FROM cna_sum ORDER BY hugoGeneSymbol LIMIT 1), #{genomicDataFilters[0].hugoGeneSymbol}) AS hugoGeneSymbol, #{profileType} AS profileType, 'NA' AS label, 'NA' AS value, CAST( (() - COALESCE((SELECT value_count FROM cna_sum ORDER BY hugoGeneSymbol LIMIT 1), 0)) AS INT) AS count, NULL AS uniqueCount, NULL AS sampleIdsStr ORDER BY hugoGeneSymbol, value

WITH profiled_count AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sgp.sample_unique_id) AS count FROM sample_to_gene_panel_derived sgp INNER JOIN gene_panel_to_gene_derived gptg ON sgp.gene_panel_id = gptg.gene_panel_id WHERE sgp.sample_unique_id IN (
) AND gptg.gene = #{genomicDataFilter.hugoGeneSymbol} AND sgp.alteration_type = 'MUTATION_EXTENDED' ), mutated_count AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sample_unique_id) AS count FROM genomic_event_derived WHERE AND hugo_gene_symbol = #{genomicDataFilter.hugoGeneSymbol} AND variant_type = 'mutation' ) SELECT CAST((SELECT count FROM mutated_count) AS INT) AS mutatedCount, CAST((SELECT count FROM profiled_count) - (SELECT count FROM mutated_count) AS INT) AS notMutatedCount, CAST(() - (SELECT count FROM profiled_count) AS INT) AS notProfiledCount
